title: GIVING TUESDAY - Chamber Gives Back - Convoy of Hope
seo_title: Giving Tuesday Volunteer Shift at Convoy of Hope
description: This is a volunteer shift at Convoy of Hope's Hands of Hope program, where volunteers count, sort, and box or bag product and help clean up their work area at the end. It is open to youth ages 10 and up; ages 10-12 must come with a parent or legal guardian, and ages 13-17 need a signed parental consent form. It runs Tuesday, December 1, 2026, 6:30 to 8:30 PM at the Convoy of Hope World Distribution Center, One Convoy Drive, Springfield, MO; registration is required, and closed-toe shoes and a current liability waiver are required.
venue: Convoy of Hope World Distribution Center
